scope: Explicit later local description events; record_ids are fixed to actual affected records.

events.action: Unify graph identities and qualify exported relationships and citations
events.note: Local graph projection now uses one contextual identity per entity, distinguishes work-level institutional matches from selected-edition links, retains title-level ISBN uncertainty, and derives citations from the source title. Typed relation assertions and a versioned validation profile are introduced. No publication date, original source snapshot or PDF changed.
events.responsible_service: Museum of One Digital Archive Library
events.method: Source-based metadata implementation and regression validation
events.date_kind: Catalogue description event; not a publication, source review or acquisition date

events.action: Record inspected public ORCID profile evidence
events.note: The official ORCID public person API returned the credited name Dorian Vale and the Museum of One website. This confirms a matching public profile, not independently verified biographical or affiliation claims. Original creator arrays and source snapshots are unchanged.
events.responsible_service: Museum of One Digital Archive Library
events.date_kind: Local authority review and catalogue description event; not a publication or original creation date

events.action: Link byte-verified OSF access copies of selected editions
events.note: Each OSF PDF was retrieved anonymously and matched by SHA-256 and byte count against the selected archive reading copy. Earlier OSF editions remain separate. DOI, publication dates, original PDFs and rights notices are unchanged; no private OSF material is included.
events.responsible_service: Museum of One Digital Archive Library
events.method: Edition DOI reconciliation and anonymous file hash verification
events.date_kind: Catalogue description event; not a publication or acquisition date

events.action: Reconcile current repository metadata after verified metadata-only corrections
events.note: Current creator/contributor roles, language, alternate identifiers and the affected source journal, related-identifier and resource-type fields were checked against public Zenodo records. Field assertions distinguish this current review from the original dated metadata snapshots, which remain unchanged. Publication titles, authorship, dates, DOI/version identities, descriptions and deposited PDF bytes are unchanged. The operational manual remains distinct from its sibling dataset.
events.responsible_service: Museum of One Digital Archive Library
events.method: Source-qualified current metadata projection with independent public readback, regression checks and file/source preservation guards
events.date_kind: Catalogue description event; not a publication, deposit, acquisition or new edition date
